scope: One diagnostic Ordinary trace and one diagnostic D2 trace. Shares describe profiled kernel budgets, not predicted speedups. Exact existing primary output retained for each.
observations: D2 executes NVFP4 fused GateUp Sm120MatrixProjectionKernel<true,2,2,false,float>: two M16 tiles for3 actual rows. Source calls MMA for both tiles; a single-tile specialization is untested.
D2 FP8 uses Sm120DirectProjectionFixedBatchKernel<3>: weights reused but three separate MMA calls. PackedT3 dispatch is currently guarded to26B dimensions, excluding12B K3840.
Ordinary is already a full CUDA Graph; D2 already chains the generation on device. Host launch replacement is not the first target.
Target BF16 head already reuses weights across3 verifier rows; historical T3 WMMA head and several attention/warp probes were rejected. Do not repeat without new evidence.
Native and vLLM use the same12B mixed FP8/NVFP4 source, but differ in output arithmetic/streams; acceptance alone is not an explanation for the full gap.
priority: 12B-only D2 NVFP4 GateUp single M16 tile
Ordinary FP8 memory/instruction diagnosis and one bounded kernel candidate
12B normalization/residual/quantization fusion preserving all BF16 rounds
Assistant BF16 GEMV/head diagnosis preserving Assistant weights
